decisions.reason: As only a single mentioned product rather than a prominently developed line, the construction site dumper carries less visible commitment and is easier to cut if 2020–2021 demand did not clearly validate it, despite some tendency to justify the launch.

The inclined furniture lift was launched as a multi-model line with its own page, so the firm has made a visible and resource-intensive commitment that management is likely to continue defending, especially if any weak results can be blamed on temporary market disruption.

The inclined building material lift appears closest to the firm's construction and lifting direction and was presented as a full product line, which makes management more likely to persist with it and justify the investment.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift is more specialized and likely harder to support than the broader lift lines, but its public launch and fit with the firm's lifting know-how still make continued commitment somewhat more likely than withdrawal.
